outcome: Managers and executives can distinguish realised/verified savings from identified opportunities and can open the underlying cost evidence instead of relying on unsupported ROI claims.
valueHypothesis: Making verified savings and opportunity visible at the point of decision improves trust, prioritisation and the customer's ability to defend ROI internally.

valueMetric.name: evidence-backed-financial-value
valueMetric.baselineSource: authoritative workforce/cost evidence exposed by the existing value cockpit
valueMetric.resultSource: existing VCU report or value-cockpit evidence only

acceptanceCriteria: The home experience contains the VECTOR_VERIFIED_VALUE_V1 marker.
No numeric savings value is invented when authoritative evidence is unavailable.
Realised/verified value and identified opportunity are labelled separately.
The user can navigate from the value summary to the existing cost/value surface.

observability.dashboard: existing hosted browser/UI proof plus product-factory proof receipt

rollback.method: revert the Vector presentation overlay change without mutating the sealed runtime

reusePlan: The value-evidence component becomes a reusable executive/manager primitive for future cost, energy, overtime, agency and productivity savings.
automationPlan: Future savings features must bind to evidence fields rather than adding bespoke unsupported ROI copy.
claimBoundary: This feature does not claim customer savings unless the existing runtime exposes evidence for those savings.
